resolutions.researcher_notes: Original Aramco ref (aramcos-strategic-gas-expansion-...25bn-contract-awards) repeatedly ReadTimeouts in url_verifier and could not be Wayback-recovered, so replaced. 2028 is program-level: BlackRidge project profile states MGS-3 completion Q4 2028; boereport (verbatim reprint of the Aramco 1 Jul 2024 press release) states capacity added 'by 2028'. StartYear1=2028 (start-of-operation) is consistent with the Q4 2028 program completion target; no source gives a per-line/package EWPS-4-EWPS-6 in-service date distinct from the program. boereport is a developer (Aramco) reprint, so effectively one independent source (BlackRidge) + developer -> medium.

CONTRADICTION/DERIVATION FLAG: MEED states Package 6 lays '56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-4 to EWPS-6, covering 370km' — i.e. 370 km for BOTH lines 3 and 4 combined. GEM row is the '4' (line four) segment at LengthKnown=185.00 km, which is exactly half of 370 (one of the two parallel lines). 185 km is therefore a reasonable per-line derivation, but no source states 185 km explicitly; the only published figure is 370 km for the pair. If GEM intends 185 as one of the two 185-km lines this is internally consistent; flag for reviewer in case GEM should instead carry a companion '3' row so the two sum to 370. MEED corroborated by worldoil/OGJ on the same Package-6/EWPS scope but only MEED gives the 370 km number.

StartCountryOrArea=EndCountryOrArea=Saudi Arabia. MGS-3 EWPS-4-to-EWPS-6 is an east-west trunk pipeline entirely within Saudi Arabia (Aramco Master Gas System). Confirmed by MEED and World Oil (two independent trade outlets), plus OGJ, all describing the MGS-3 network as Kingdom-of-Saudi-Arabia infrastructure.

Owner1=Aramco 100%. MGS-3 (Master Gas System) is a wholly-owned Saudi Aramco program; Aramco is the awarding entity/owner of all 17 EPC packages including Package 6 (EWPS-4 to EWPS-6). Confirmed independently by MEED, World Oil, and OGJ (which reports Aramco awarding the EWPS pipeline contracts). No third-party equity ownership found.
